reviews.text: I love the new space! The self wash area has 3 private rooms. Perfect for my dog who gets anxious with other dogs and has a big voice about it.

I have been coming to this location for about a year and a half to two years now. Every single time I’ve come in, every single employee has been overly helpful and knowledgeable about various foods. I’ve been dealing with tons of allergies and inflammation for one of my dogs and throughout the whole process, the owner Jaime, has been more than helpful narrowing down his various allergy testing and other medical tests. She’s extremely knowledgeable about diets, allergens, nutritional needs, etc. In fact, I would go as far as saying, she is more knowledgeable than the majority of the vets who are limited on nutritional knowledge. I am beyond grateful for the combined hours and time that everyone over here has put into my pets food journey. I will be a longtime customer as long as I have animals. As someone who has had dogs for the past 20 years, I’ve been into my fair share of pet stores. This is hands-down the absolute best I’ve been in. I will continue driving 20 minutes away from home just to shop here.
Always do a great job
Beautiful store and great people! Very kind. Can’t wait to bring my dog here for treats and grooming.

Awesome experience. We used to feed our boys other brands of  food from our local big box retailer. However I had no idea what all ingredients can be in those foods until I met Mikaela. By her recommendation of GO solutions duck formula, it has tremendously cleared up our English Bulldog’s itching and musky smell. Our Basset’s ears have never been cleaner as well. She is very knowledgeable and provided what I consider a world class shopping experience. Thanks so much for your help Mikaela. Would give 6 stars if I could.
Excellent place for pet food and service.
I used the self service dog wash. First time I've ever used one before. So much easier than washing my son's big dog in the tub and they provide shampoo, conditioner, towels, dryer and brush.

Please be mindful when grooming future fur babies - especially those with warts and any lipomas.

With that being said, for the last 10 years, we’ve always driven 45 minutes to take our fur babies here and this was our first time at their new location. The vibes in this new place felt very different. Quiet, much smaller location with dimmer lighting.. as if the original business had been bought out. The price had also increased significantly and they didn’t even put bows or bandanas on our pups like they normally do. The customer service wasn’t as friendly as usual and my dog was rudely told to be quiet in front of us after the store’s loose dog had bum rushed our dog, showing its teeth first.

Overall, we just felt uncomfortable dropping them off here and we were a bit antsy while we waited to pick them up, clearly for a reason.

The next day we inconveniently had to take her to get her wart checked after it was irritated and had opened up, so yes, we will not be returning.
Using there DIY dog wash. Very handy for me cleaning up the doodle after a day on the lake. There dog wash card is the wat to go, great discount on a prepaid card.

My dogs have never looked so good! Grooming time was reasonable, everyone in the store was friendly and responsive, and the groomers clearly know their business. My dogs are serious wigglers, but no blood followed them out of the grooming area (that has happened in another grooming place). Their ears, though! The cleanest their ears have ever been. We've found our new grooming home.
Friendly and helpful staff

Don’t recommend! I got there at 546 today on a Thursday to do a self serve dog wash. The girl at the counter said I was too late that they stop 30 minutes before closing and that the store closes at 6. That’s not what the sign says online. They need to go by what they post!

First time here, pet wash station was closed the only person working didn’t know how to use the computer in there to charge me so they wouldn’t allow us to bathe him. 45 minutes of a drive for nothing..

I can’t thank enough the staff at Fur Babies, I came in with a lost dog today to get him checked for a chip, and they gave me free food and treats for taking this pup in. Such beautiful kind people! Plus they let me bathe him and they covered all cost🥹❤️thank you again!!!! He’s in good hands 🙏🏽 …

This is the only place I’ll be going to, to buy my big boy good quality dog food from now on!
I was feeding him HEB Heritage Ranch “Healthy Weight” because it was cost affective 😔, little did I know my poor guy would develop allergies from poultry later on. His skin has gotten pretty bad, I’ve tried everything and different ointments as well and nothing!

I now know, it’s definitely the dog food! A huge thank you to the lady who helped me out today. So sweet and kind! Very knowledgeable and answered all my questions! I’ll be going back and I’m definitely posting updated photos a month from now to show the difference on his skin. I absolutely am thankful for this sweet little place, right here in Kingwood!

Update: Within a single month there’s been great improvement with Debo’s skin allergies. Again I cannot thank y’all enough. Progress photos have been added.
I brought my dog for the first time today. The staff were all so sweet to my girl. Mercedes gave her a beautiful haircut complete with little bows. Their pricing was great! Highly recommend!
Love the cut they did on my mini Bernedoodle. He smells amazing and looks so adorable. Wonderful experience overall.
Absolutely fabulous customer service. Every time I go in they are so helpful. So appreciative. Good dog food and treats and great help . They always answer all my questions .

my fur babies LOVED the duck feet!!!
😁😁 …

Fur Babies is the best in every way!!  Extensive knowledge regarding pet health and nutrition.  They spend as much time as you need helping you with your questions finding the right solution for any issue.  The grooming department is FANTASTIC.  I’ve had Tessa groom my Shih Tzu babies for many years now, and wouldn’t want anyone else.  She loves my two babies like they were her own, and a previous Shih Tzu of mine was a tough groom because she only liked me, until she met Tessa. Tessa was the only one she let touch her or really even look at her without getting sassy about it.  She has a gift of dealing with pets and is a great person as well.   The entire staff in both departments genuinely cares about your pets.

I’ve been bringing my Doodle to Fur Babies for 3 years & have had a great experience every time. My dog actually gets excited when we enter the front door & knows it’s spa day! I never have to worry about the outcome of her grooming because Tessa does a fabulous job. The front desk employees, bathers & groomers are so friendly. I highly recommend Fur Babies.

We are sooo happy to have Fur Babies in our community. We have 10 pups and the momma dog; she landed on our driveway 4 days before giving birth. Amy at Fur Babies has been a lifeline! She has given us such great advise, everything from food portions, meal timing,  even ways to deal with pen up keep and cleaning. We were way off on all that, and her advice was an immediate game changer! Within a day, our lives became sooo much easier. We are so so grateful for her willingness to help us, even letting me text her on her off hours, and super informative. Thank you Amy!!!

I am GRATful Beyond words! You have no idea the difference my dogs skin is. ❤️ 🐶  when we came here, my dog had very itchy skin and we were just having some problems with her like fleas and itching skin n stuff and she is so so so much better. Thankful Fur Babies and their staff listened to me and helped us with our individual needs.🙌
We love Kitty! She is a fantastic groomer with an attention to detail! Will be back everytime!
Very professional and kind. Katherine does great work!
We LOVE kitty and the crew there! They always make us feel comfortable and are always happy to answer any questions we have!
Very knowledgeable staff. You're not going to get the same products and support anywhere else.
Never going back. They cannot maintain appointments, pet records and give the worst cuts

This is my go-to when I need to give my dog a bath, and I don't feel like doing it at home. Their self-serve dog wash option is super convenient, the tubs are huge (I have a golden retriever lol), and they provide everything you need. We always take advantage of the punch cards - amazing deal!!!

I absolutely love Fur Babies as much as our Maggie loves going to what we call her Doggy Spa Day!  They all take such great care of Maggie!  I leave her knowing she is in the very best hands and there is no worry on my part at all!

The staff is nothing but amazing, loving and kind to both the doggy parents as well as our family doggy members!

Thank you so much Fur Babies!  Our family loves yall🫶
Great selection and service

This is our go to place for our babies food!  They are always so friendly and will take time with you if you have questions. I took my little dachshund with me today and ended up buying more food than expected. Amy was so kind to carry out the bags of dog food to my car since I couldn’t handle that and my baby all at once!  Excellent customer service!  That’s why we keep going back!
I take my dog here regularly, she loves the staff. She always comes home smelling great! I recommend them for any dog type or size.

Review for Fur Babies – Extremely Disappointed

Went to Fur Babies for the first time today, hoping to try their self-grooming service. Yes, we arrived 45 minutes before closing, but that should still be plenty of time for a basic greeting or some kind of acknowledgment. Instead, the employee was on the phone and didn’t even glance up. No smile, no "hi," no “we're about to close soon,” nothing. We stood there for 10 minutes — completely ignored.

The lack of basic customer service was astounding. It wasn't just bad — it was downright rude. It felt like we were an inconvenience simply for walking in. There was zero effort to be welcoming or helpful. I completely agree with the woman who left a review two months ago — this place has a severely unwelcoming vibe. I can’t quite put my finger on it either, but the energy in that shop is just… off.

It takes two seconds to acknowledge a customer. A nod. A wave. Something. Instead, we were treated like we didn’t exist. For a place that claims to care about pets and their people, the coldness was shocking.

We won’t be back — ever. Plenty of other pet grooming places in town that actually want your business. Avoid this one if you value basic respect and human decency.
Very friendly staff. They ordered dog food for me and it came in quickly. Also was a good price. They have a lot of products to select from.

Been a huge fan of Fur Babies for years, I’m so thankful for the expert advice and direction all of their friendly employees have shared with me. Jamie, Mikaela, and Abby - yall are truly awesome 🐾 My pack of 5 love you guys! …

**SELF-WASH ONLY REVIEW**

This was my first time washing my dogs here after hearing about the great price, so I decided to give it a try. Unfortunately, my experience was disappointing. The woman who took my payment wasn’t very helpful or informative. I have two small dogs under five pounds, and the overall vibe was so off that I ended up washing my other dog at home instead.

At other self-wash locations, the staff is typically welcoming and willing to guide first-time customers, but that wasn’t the case here. A few issues I encountered:

1. The water nozzle had only one pressure setting, which was quite strong—too much for delicate areas like the face.
2. There was no information provided about the shampoo, and the only additional product available was a leave-in conditioner spray with no details on its ingredients. I didn’t feel comfortable using it, so I used my own products.
3. The blow-drying situation was frustrating. Drying is done right at the wash station with no separate area. A groomer on the other side of the wall managed to get both me and my dog wet again just as I was almost done drying. Imagine trying to dry a Maltese next to a Husky—it felt like a snow globe of fur flying everywhere. **Additionally, the dryer itself wasn’t very strong and didn’t offer different settings for blowing strength or temperature. One of the main reasons I opted for a self-wash service was to complete the bath quickly, but the weak dryer made that difficult. It was fine today since it was warm outside, but I prefer to fully dry my girls regardless of the weather.**
4. Several employees (walked past me without a simple greeting or acknowledgment, which leads to my biggest issue…
5. **The vibe.** I can’t quite put my finger on it, but the atmosphere felt unwelcoming—almost as if I was intruding. Washing my dogs is usually an enjoyable bonding experience, and I appreciate friendly, engaging interactions with staff. Unfortunately, I didn’t get that here. Instead, I felt uncomfortable and eager to leave.
6. I purchased the 5-for-$50 deal, which comes with a punch card. Knowing my lifestyle, I probably won’t keep track of it, so I asked if they had a system to store the information and check me in electronically. The response was simply "no," and she handed me a card with some holes punched in it.

**On a positive note, the towels were very nice, and the lady working in the retail section was helpful when I stepped out to ask for a hand.** But overall, It’s disappointing because all they had to do was be a little kind, show some concern, or at least act like they appreciated my business—just a little effort would have made me give them another shot.

I won’t be coming back—message received loud and clear.

The self wash area was quite dirty and there was so much hair all over the floor. The clean towels were covered in dog hair as well. Nice concept but won’t be coming back. Also no one even said hi or welcome in at any point. I didn’t like the vibe at all.

Great people, with excellent advice on pet nutrition. My dog was having allergy issues with a high quality brand, yet they were able to help me find another brand that helped eliminate my dog's allergies.

This place is awesome!! Ms.Kathleen did phenomenal job with our family dog, Lilo. She was so happy when we picked her up. She didn't want to leave. A special thanks for a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. We will definitely be going back and taking our other dog, Tae. 😊🙏🏽💓💯 …
They sell my dog food for less than chews. And I can get it in store.

Absolutely can't recommend the new groomer Kat enough!! She's been grooming poodles that I've owned since 2019, and had always taken her time and given them the best haircuts of their lives! I've followed her wherever she's gone! You won't be disappointed!
Friendly staff and great selection!

This locally owned store has high quality pet food and supplies my dogs love. Store hours work beautifully with my busy schedule. Friendly staff are helpful and knowledgeable. Love having this Kingwood option for my furry family members!

Super helpful and friendly every time I come here ! :)

Knowledgeable as well !

Awesome place to shop for my pupper hehe
